note: Alberta Parks campground in Cypress Hills Provincial Park's Elkwater townsite, an open loop near the registration booth with a playground and horseshoe pitch; walking trails lead to the Elkwater Lake waterfront and the townsite. Water is shut off from mid-September; year-round showers, flush toilets and drinking water are at the Lakeview shower house nearby. --Claude
